sources.evidence: The text after axial-impedance coefficients uses a simply supported shear-elastic cupula and lambda_gamma = 8*pi. This is a macromechanical approximation, not a measured local bundle map.

Appendix equation 4 integrates gamma*lambda/A^2 along thickness. The cupula solid volume and endolymph volume are distinct coordinates. Table A.1 writes h_c = sqrt(A_c/(4*pi)); the square root must not be lost in plain-text extraction.
The healthy cupula attaches around its perimeter. Kinocilium-to-cupula coupling is a putative mechanical link. Local bundle mechanics and adaptation are not supplied by a mean organ displacement.
A separate three-dimensional model reports position-dependent crista shear. Its human modulus and temperature conclusions are indirect; no parameter from this work is installed here.

derivedClosure.authorship: Derived here from the circular homogeneous shear approximation; not a literal transcription of a human finite-element field.
derivedClosure.normalization: integral_disk u dA = Q; u = 0 at the perimeter
derivedClosure.attachment: root lies on the lower circular boundary; declared length extends in positive local y; rigid root and no-slip tip
derivedClosure.bundleInput: excitation polarity * (u_tip - u_root), converted from metres to nanometres
derivedClosure.flow: same spatial mode applied to the separate solid flow Qdot; no elapsed time invented

limitations: No anatomical radius, material modulus, bundle location, length or polarity default.
No projection of endolymph volume into a solid hair-bundle displacement.
Quasi-static homogeneous circular shear closure; detailed crista shape, bending, pore-scale flow, attachment compliance and active bundle forces are omitted.
Projection supplies no additional inertia, damping, neuronal spike or MET adaptation.
The published organ's inertial approximation is not upgraded by this shape reconstruction.
A connected organ must reconcile the declared field's stiffness with its own mechanical parameters before physiological interpretation.
Independent source numerical agreement is not human anatomical calibration or Avatar balance.
